description.value: A remote conservancy at the junction of Tagish Lake and Graham Inlet, about 35 kilometres northwest of Atlin in northern BC. Established in partnership with the Taku River Tlingit First Nation, its Tlingit name (X̱áat Yádi Aani) refers to a village near where humpback whitefish congregated. The conservancy protects a culturally significant landscape of islands, bays, and shoreline with no developed visitor facilities.
